notes.title: Announcing At Fate's End: the Next Game from the Sundered Team!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're so very excited to reveal what the [b]Sundered [/b]team has been cooking up over the past few years! Behold, [b]At Fate's End[/b], the action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love.[/p][p][/p][p]Cue the Announcement Trailer![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="XuXlG-xjENc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Yes, yes! Head straight to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210150/At_Fates_End/"]store page[/url] to learn all the basics about the new project! Please wishlist and follow![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210150/At_Fates_End/" style="button"]At Fate's End Store Page[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//32943393/3c36c2d9b71863d6c4146313bd5f4d37eb14db8a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]But if you're reading this, I reckon that you've been following us for some time - that you know and love [b]Sundered[/b], or are maybe even well-acquainted with our other projects, [b]Jotun[/b] and [b]Spiritfarer! [/b]So if you're interested, please read on for a handy inside scoop in FAQ-form just for you![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]At Fate's End FAQ![/h2][p][/p][p][b]What is “AT FATE’S END”?[/b][/p][p]The game’s Creative Director Nick says it best: “With At Fate’s End, we’re taking everything we learned from [i]Spiritfarer[/i] — that rich emotional core, that interplay of mechanics and narrative — and pushing it into new territory. This is a more intense, more action-driven game, but no less intimate. It’s about how families break apart — and how they might come back together.”[/p][p]Personally, I'm also seeing some DNA from [i]Jotun[/i] and [i]Sundered[/i] in here too - it's the O.G. Thunder Lotus team, after all!
[/p][p][b]Is this a multiplayer game?[/b][/p][p]No, [i]At Fate’s End[/i] is a single player game.
[/p][p][b]What platforms will the game be on?[/b][/p][p][i]At Fate’s End[/i] is coming in 2026 on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and with Xbox Game Pass.
[/p][p][b]How much will At Fate’s End cost?[/b][/p][p]To be confirmed - stay tuned! We can confirm that the game will be premium (i.e. not Free-to-play), and also made available to users with Game Pass Ultimate subscriptions.
[/p][p][b]Who’s making this game?[/b][/p][p][i]At Fate’s End[/i] is the gorgeous new production from the creative team behind our studio’s first three games: [i]Jotun, Sundered[/i], and [i]Spiritfarer[/i]. The team’s changed slightly over the years, mostly by adding a few key members to the mix. [i]At Fate’s End[/i] is definitely the team’s most ambitious game yet![/p][p][/p][p][b]How long have you been working on the game?[/b][/p][p]The [i]Sundered [/i]Team started dreaming up [i]At Fate’s End [/i]in 2021, while polishing the final updates for [i]Spiritfarer[/i].
[/p][p][b]If I loved Sundered, will I love At Fate's End?[/b][/p][p]The team is convinced that if you loved Sundered's action (and don’t shy away from games with a lot of story), you’ll find a lot to love — and all the feels — in [i]At Fate’s End[/i] too!
[/p][p][b]What is the best way to support the game?[/b][/p][p]Other than wishlisting and following the game and signing up to our [url="https://thunderlotusgames.com/games/at-fates-end/#gameSignup"]mailing list[/url], you can also help us by getting the word out on social media and playing an active role in our community! You'll find all our social links on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2210150/At_Fates_End/"]store page[/url].
[/p][p][b]How do I get in touch with the team?[/b][/p][p]The easiest way to get in touch with us is through our Steam Community Forums or on [url="https://discord.com/invite/TLG"]Discord[/url]. We’re most responsive there, and thanks for your patience: we keep regular office hours in the Eastern Time Zone.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That's all she wrote! We're looking forward to sharing more as the project over the coming months. If you have any questions, reach out to us in any of the places I mentioned above![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers y'all![/p][p][/p][p]Rodrigue @ Thunder Lotus[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//32943393/e95f068e2e562d0b428b35288b5dd4a50a7bd4f2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Lovecraft-inspired Metroidvania Sundered is currently free on the Epic Games Store
notes.content:
Sundered, developer Thunder Lotus' wonderful (and gorgeously animated) Lovecraft-inspired Metroidvania, is currently free to download on the Epic Store.

Sundered - the follow-up to Thunder Lotus' Viking-themed boss-rush adventure Jotun - first emerged from the depths back in 2017, and sees players, cast in the role of Eshe, exploring the labyrinthine underground passageways of a long-forgotten desert ruin, at the behest of a mysterious entity known as the Shining Trapezohedron.

Although Sundered follows a familiar Metroidvania template, gradually opening out as players uncover handy new items and upgrades on their antediluvian adventures, its sprawling subterranean corridors are far from immutable, and the world is subtly rearranged upon death.

notes.title: Sundered: Eldritch Edition is now free on the Epic Games Store, and there's more to come
notes.content:
Despite being expected to come to an end along with 2019, it appears that the Epic Games Store is going to continue its weekly game giveaways for awhile yet. After finishing the year with 12 freebies over 12 days, and starting 2020 with three more, Epic has made the hand-drawn Metroidvania Sundered: Eldritch Edition free for the taking, and has another one teed up for next week. 

Sundered is up for grabs until 11 am ET on January 16, at which point Horace, "a massive platformer with an even bigger heart," will take its place. Horace, which released on Steam in July 2019, isn't actually available on Epic yet, but is slated to be free from January 16-23.

Epic still hasn't formally committed to ongoing free games in 2020 as far as I know, but neither has it said (or even hinted) that the well is about to run dry. And for now, the new games are still coming, so we'll continue to remind you about them when they show up. After all, nobody wants to miss out on free stuff, right?

You can grab Sundered for free here, while Horace—when the time comes—is here.

notes.title: Sundered: Eldritch Edition is going free on the Epic Games Store later this week
notes.content:
The Epic Games Store began giving away weekly free games in May to mark its first big sale, a process it extended in June to the end of 2019. It wrapped up the year in a big way, with 12 daily giveaways. Then 2020 rolled around, and we got three more free games.

And that's not the end of the ride either. Darksiders, Darksiders 2, and Steep are still free for now, but once January 9 arrives, Sundered: Eldritch Edition will take their place. Sundered is a hand-drawn Metroidvania developed by Jotun studio Thunder Lotus, in which players can either resist or embrace ancient Eldritch powers. That sort of thing rarely comes without a price, and, oh yes, here it is: "At the cost of your humanity." 

Omelettes and eggs, I suppose. The Eldritch Edition includes local co-op support for up to four players, plus new areas to explore and a new quest chain with unique rewards and a brand-new boss, along with all the regular updates that have been released since Sundered launched.

Epic hasn't said yet what its long-term plan is—whether it intends to continue handing out games through some or all of 2020, or if this is just a bit of spillover bookkeeping. We'll let you know if and when it does, and for now, hey, it's another free game. Sundered: Eldritch Edition will be yours for the taking on the Epic Games Store between January 9-16.

notes.title: Gorgeous Metroidvania Sundered comes to Switch and Xbox this month with added co-op
notes.content:
Developer Thunder Lotus has announced that its wonderful Lovecraft-inspired Metroidvania, Sundered, is coming to Xbox One and Switch on December 21st, with a host of new features including co-op.

Thunder Lotus is calling this enhanced version Sundered: Eldritch Edition, as is befitting of the game's Lovecraftian themes. Sundered unfolds far beneath the earth, as protagonist Eshe, at the behest of a entity known as the Shining Trapezohedron, ventures ever-deeper through the labyrinthine, interconnected passageways of a desert ruin. Needless to say, long-lost civilisations, ancient forces, and unspeakable creatures from beyond the veil await.

As with Thunder Lotus' Nordic boss-rush adventure Jotun, Sundered is a beautiful experience - its strange corners and stranger creatures brought to life through hand-drawn, strikingly animated art. Its procedurally generated map, which subtly alters the peripheral parts of the world after each death isn't, admittedly, quite as memorable as those you might find in a more traditionally designed Metroidvania, but areas are distinctive and visually impactful.

notes.title: The Not a Metroidvania bundle includes 4 great Metroidvanias

If only you could have heard the RPS treehouse chat a few months ago, during the great Metroidvania debate of 2017. Battle lines were drawn. On the one side: John, insisting that of course Dead Cells isn’t a Metroidvania. On the other side: everyone else, calling John an old fogey for insisting on overly strict and out-dated genre boundaries. On the other other side: the sensible people, who probably didn’t get involved because this is a silly discussion that’s of no consequence whatsoever.

Still, I was in the second group, and can’t help but picture the smug look on John’s face as he dropped news of the “Not a Metroidvania” Steam bundle into our Trello this morning. It includes the best game of 2017, the splendid Sundered, the Dark Souls-esque Salt and Sanctuary, and the comparatively essless Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition. John likes all of them, but what does he know. (more…)

notes.title: Dead Cells, Salt and Sanctuary going cheap in Steam's 'Not a Metroidvania' sale
notes.content:
Steam's Not a Metroidvania sale gathers Guacamelee, Salt and Sanctuary, Sundered and Dead Cells. Individually, you stand to save up to 40 percent on each game—or 50 percent if you buy them as a bundle. As the name of the sale suggests, these indie gems aim to sidestep the sweeping Metroidvania genre label. I like 'em all for different reasons.   

DrinkBox Studios' Guacamelee, for example, is a fast-firing explosion of combos and colour. Thunder Lotus Games' Sundered is a gorgeous sidescroller with some larger than life bosses (look at the teeny, tiny hero fighting that gigantic baddie in the header image above); while Motion Twin's Dead Cells boasts a dizzying array of weapons and uber-cool animations. 

Ska Studios' Salt and Sanctuary is a 2D Dark Souls-a-like. It's my favourite of the four, and as such gets a closer look:

"In these lovingly crafted 2D platformers, you'll explore and battle through unique non-linear worlds, discover new items and abilities which will allow you to progress beyond otherwise impassable obstacles, and revisit older areas along the way," says the sale's Steam blurb. "These games are proof that there's plenty of room for creative variation inside these simple rules of gameplay, but agreeing on a single term to describe them can be tough... May we suggest Castletroid? Vanimet?"

Call them what you like, but I assure you they're worth your time. With 40 percent off, Guacamelee's Super Turbo Championship Edition costs £6.89/$8.99, Salt and Sanctuary costs £8.15/$10.79, and Sundered costs £9.29/$11.99. With 33 percent off Dead Cells costs £11.38/$13.39. 

Together, the Not a Metroidvania sale gathers the lot for £28.56/$36.12. It runs from now till Friday, June 8.

notes.title: Frost Warning on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/3fb53515466d9814bbcd4275b42bd880403f03b9.png[/img]

[h1] Jotun Thunders onto Nintendo Switch in Two Weeks! [/h1]

Hey everyone,  

Truly stoked to share this epic news with y'all: get ready for six more weeks of winter, as we're finally bringing [i]Jotun[/i] to the Nintendo Switch! [i]Jotun: Valhalla Edition[/i] drops on the vaunted console worldwide on [b]April 27th, 2018![/b]  

Have a gander at the launch trailer, why dontcha?

[url=https://youtu.be/lAN263KlreM] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/7445b45bd7c4c981f03c33a4221789be208601c1.png[/img][/url]

Needless to say, we're very excited to be bringing our first game to the Switch - we're all life-long Nintendo fans over here, and have been in absolute lurve with the Switch since launch. 

We wanted to take the time and make sure we were bringing the best possible version of [i]Jotun[/i] to the system. Happily, the Switch has the horsepower to showcase [i]Jotun[/i] in all its hand-drawn glory, even in handheld mode, so those who played the Wii U version especially will notice the great job the team has done remastering the graphics for the Switch release. 

Also, since we play a lot with scale in [i]Jotun,[/i] Thora often being dwarfed by titanic bosses, we had to rework some of the gameplay to allow for play on a potentially much smaller screen. 

[h1]Keep your eyes on our social channels for a chance to win!  [/h1]

We hope you're all stoked to play the game on the Switch and, say, to beat Valhalla Mode without using God Powers *while commuting to work*!  

We're so happy to finally have one of our games on the Switch that [b]we'll be holding drawings to win Jotun Switch codes and other sweet goodies! [/b] Recommend you stay tuned to our social channels between now and launch day, is all I'm sayin'...  

[url=https://www.facebook.com/ThunderLotusGames/] Facebook[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/ThunderLotus] Twitter [/url]

So stay frosty, y'all! Jotun is out on Switch in two weeks! 

[h1]What's happening with Sundered?[/h1]

That's a very good question, Bill! 

The team remains hard at work lovingly polishing delicious DLC for the game. I can confirm that said DLC has been content-complete for a few weeks (and that it's awesome), but we're still tweaking it 'til it's up to your/our standards of excellence. We're tantalizingly close to being able to share [i]Sundered [/i]news with you - news that goes beyond the DLC itself. If I say anymore, I'll be summarily killed. But I assure y'all that you won't be disappointed.

Stay tuned!

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Our Year in Review!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/2ab75398537e6e150f3b65d09c99c7f57769b077.png[/img]

[h1][b]Happy Holidays from Thunder Lotus![/b][/h1]

Hey everyone,

We're celebrating the end of a banner year here at Thunder Lotus! We welcomed over [b] two million [/b] new TLG game owners to the family in 2017, and wanted to thank each and every one of you for your overwhelming support of [i] Jotun [/i] and [i] Sundered [/i]! Happy Holidays from all of us here at Thunder Lotus Games to the best damn fans in gaming!

Below, I'm sharing a look back on our last twelve months, but I'd be remiss if I didn't first direct your attention to the [b] Thunder Lotus Collection! [/b] 

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5432/The_Thunder_Lotus_Collection/] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/da279b902b3507a0746d5919930bfbaab04fd72a.png[/img] [/url]

We're happy to report that both [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/323580/Jotun_Valhalla_Edition/]Jotun[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/535480/Sundered/]Sundered[/url] are on sale for the [b] Steam Winter Sale, [/b]with [i] Sundered [/i] enjoying its [b] deepest discount yet [/b] at -50%! If you were still on the fence about [i] Sundered,[/i] it's a great time to pick it up (and spread the word)!

Do note as well that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5432/The_Thunder_Lotus_Collection/]The Thunder Lotus Collection[/url] adds an [b] extra -10% discount [/b] on top of that if you purchase our titles together (or are looking to complete your collection!). It's a crazy good deal, yo - worth a share, dontcha think?

This concludes our yuletide PSA. And now...

[h1][b]Our Year In Pictures[/b][/h1]

We wanted to take a moment to look back on a wonderful (and wonderfully busy) year for our team!  

We hit the ground running in [b]January[/b] this year, putting the finishing touches on a then-secret Kickstarter project [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/sundered-a-horrifying-fight-for-survival-and-sanit/]that you should all be quite familiar with by now![/url] Here, Will goofs off with Sam from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Compulsion%20Games]Compulsion Games[/url] during the filming of a Kickstarter promo video: 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/d457ec27e25aa89a24a535fe47f881ca2d594264.png[/img]

It was a stellar month: thanks to our awesome fans, we quickly [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/sundered-a-horrifying-fight-for-survival-and-sanit/posts/1785423]powered through funding milestones[/url] throughout the first hours and days of the campaign, and meanwhile, we were declared co-winners of the [url=http://quebec.ubisoft.com/en/winners-of-the-ubisoft-indie-series-presented-by-national-bank/]Ubisoft Indie Series![/url] 

[url=http://quebec.ubisoft.com/en/winners-of-the-ubisoft-indie-series-presented-by-national-bank/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ed56cb0a8f056a7558c288225d3c0be7db1bcede.jpg[/img][/url] 

Oh, and we caught the eye of one of our heroes. 

[url=https://twitter.com/RealGDT/status/823204924011978754][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/d1eb183431ffc2494df8668b23bec4a212972908.png[/img][/url]

January also kicked off a series of cross-country trips which brought us first to [b]PAX South[/b] in San Antonio.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/9ad5e876c5edbd29a18b9b6f9b1f354a7e8e21dd.jpg[/img]

With our backers' tremendous support, we closed [i]Sundered's[/i] Kickstarter campaign in February [b]800% funded,[/b] due in no small part to the surprise announcement of our partnership with the lovely and talented folks at [b]Limited Run Games.[/b] (LRG's Doug pictured here with our Art Director at MIX!)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/e3e097e4003743a5c92b85dc3bc35beaac7a4135.jpg[/img] 

In March, our travels brought us down to the IGN offices, where we were invited to sign their wall of fame, humbled by names of gaming royalty that had come before us. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ece4a53cd9818acbe539ba66a702e904e27e9de6.jpg[/img]

Later that month, we brought a small Thunder Lotus army down to Boston to greet enthusiastic fans and media at [b]PAX East.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/ee77de446b829bfebaf4fc5129a34f72f2033c62.jpg[/img]

Spring found us bearing down in earnest through the rounds of [i]Sundered’s[/i] Alpha and Beta periods, while our resident hand-drawn animation genius’ prodigious output continued unabated.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/a8339b54ee286ab6fc491e628bcd2ab40a818d29.jpg[/img]  

Our appearance at the sunshiny [b]E3 gigantocon[/b] heralded the coming of summer and the last straightaway leading to [i]Sundered’s[/i] July release!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/39fb49eb54e9852622cd5412d7b3ebf9cbe09e46.jpg[/img]

By summer, production was rolling a mile a minute, a blur of incessant testing, tweaking, testing, re-tooling, and testing while [b]gorgeous fan art[/b] multiplied on the walls of our office.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/81d1b0e8c37edc6c7993c94f2e3a207966d33cc7.jpg[/img]

In July, a [i]Jotun[/i] free weekend added [b]two million people[/b] (of exquisite taste) to the Thunder Lotus family overnight, and before we could say [b]R'lehshyshtag',[/b] [i]Sundered[/i] was unleashed upon the world, happily catching the eye of the likes of Rock, Paper, Shotgun (among many others)!

[url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2017/08/09/sundered-review/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/9d751ed7e63e3722b4e81d9ef695b5c273199154.png[/img][/url]

Upon our return from much needed vacation time in the fall, we kept a low profile, working in hushed secrecy on [spoiler]Sundered DLC...[/spoiler]

While bringing a new creative director onto the team to head up our [b]“Top Secret!, OMG! That’s so awesome!”[/b] third project. (Gonna be a while before we can tell you more - sorry/not sorry for the tease!) ːsteammockingː

Meet Nicolas Guérin, who has that fresh "new creative director" smell!

[url=https://thunderlotusgames.com/meet-our-new-creative-director/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6918539/8c7a51115ec6b561258837120680f26d72df43a0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Much love from all of us here![/b][/h1]

That’s all she wrote, folks! Stick a fork in 2017, it’s fully done!  

From all of us here, thanks again for helping to make this the best year yet for Thunder Lotus! Stay happy and healthy this holiday season, and we’ll see you in the new year!

Cheers, and much love!  

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: Week 1: Done!
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/7bf70daf5dad56b0649575324fc7a5f11f9e7910.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26407997/6ca4b8441347a2b4da4da31b5252b1ce02ac0094.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]A word of thanks from Sundered's Creative Director.[/h1]

Wow.

Launch week is over.

As always, it was crazy. There’s nothing like the feeling of jumping off a cliff without a parachute.

And we made it.

We’re thankful for all of you who believed in us and supported us and the game. [b]Thank you all[/b] for giving [i]Sundered[/i] a chance.

We are extremely proud of the game we created, produced and shipped. I feel the game is unique and challenging and, once you get the hang of it, really fun. I hope [i]Sundered[/i] is a game you will remember for a long time.

At launch, we had some hiccups. Some of them due to excessive difficulty. We fixed that almost immediately. We’re experiencing technical difficulties on PS4. We’re fixing them. The game’s first loading is too long. We’re fixing it. Exploration doesn’t have enough variety. We’re fixing that too.

Some of you don’t like the hordes. We’re not changing them. Several of you came in with expectations of a classic Metroidvania. We are sorry for the confusion, but we won’t be changing fundamental game systems. [i]Sundered[/i] is what is it is and that’s why we love it and are proud of it.

Looking to the future, you can expect continued support. Be it additional content, bug fixes or quality-of-life improvements. [i]Sundered[/i] has tons of potential. Seeing some of you put in over 50 hours into the game within a single week is extremely satisfying and humbling. notes.title: Sundered, the Lovecraftian Metroidvania, is out now
notes.content:
Sundered, the "replayable Metroidvania" with giant boss battles, is out now. In it, you slash and stab your way through a procedurally-generated 2D labyrinth, gradually unlocking new skills and abilities that help you delve deeper.

Developers Thunder Lotus (of Jotun)  want it to be tough as nails—one of the  elements of the "core gameplay" listed in the summary of the game is simply: "die". And when that happens you'll be hauled back to a central hub and have to set off again. 

But there's a clear progression system, with success in a given area netting you items that will let you access new areas of the map. There's also a branching skill tree and "hundreds of upgrades" to play with.

It's available on Steam, GOG, and Humble Store for £13.49/$17.99, which includes a 10% launch week discount. You can also pick it up on Uplay (sans discount) and Origin.

I've been trawling through the early Steam reviews and the two most common words seem to be "beautiful" and "frustrating". That might just sum it up: if you don't mind dying an awful lot then it will reward you with some gorgeous environments and set pieces (those boss battles really do look epic).

notes.title: Sundered, the eldritch horror Metroidvania, blows away its Kickstarter goal in six hours
notes.content:
Jotun developer Thunder Lotus Games announced Sundered last year as a "replayable Metroidvania, close to Rogue Legacy and Super Metroid," set in a Lovecraft-inspired world of eldritch horrors. Neither the Thunder Lotus website nor the Steam page had much to say about it at the time (although they've both since been updated), but last week the studio announced that a Kickstarter campaign would get under on January 16. So it did—and less than 24 hours later, it has easily surpassed its goal. 

Unlike a lot of Kickstarters, this one is focused on polish and balancing, rather than the full development process: The total budget for Sundered is $700,000 CAD, Thunder Lotus said in the Kickstarter pitch, while the Kickstarter goal is just $25,000. Elements the studio hopes to improve with the extra funding include overall balance and pace, special skill tree nodes, new perks, and "what exactly defines the core gameplay experience and how we can improve it." 

"We know how important feedback is and Jotun’s alpha and beta backers transformed the game into something special. We need you to tell us what we can do better," the studio wrote. "It's about polish, feedback and using Kickstarter funds to make Sundered the best it can be." 

The Kickstarter page also provides quite a bit of information about the game itself, which will feature both hand-crafted and procedural levels, six "massive" boss fights, "hordes of dynamically spawned eldritch monsters," exploration, secrets, character upgrades, multiple endings, and frequent death. Players will have seven major abilities, such as Double-Jump, Hook Shot, and Wall Run, each of them "corruptible" into a more powerful (but not necessarily desirable) version. "Ultimately, corrupting your abilities has important gameplay repercussions and even changes the game's ending, as how corrupted you are defines which boss you'll face," the studio said. 

The campaign, estimated at about ten hours in length, tells the tale of Eshe, a scavenger who discovers the source of power behind the Terror, a cataclysmic event that brought about the end of the world centuries ago.

"The backstory tells the tale of how this strange power attracted the Valkyries, an armed group of scientific revolutionaries, and the Eschaton, mad cultists following the teachings of an obscure god, to this place," the Kickstarter page says. "As she picks up the pieces, the player uncovers the conflict that sundered the world." 

The Kickstarter campaign, which at this moment is approaching $43,000 in pledges, runs until February 16, while Sundered is expected to be ready for launch in July. That could change, however, depending on how things unfold. "With Sundered, the complexity and amount of systems we're bringing together can cause our heads to spin, requiring a ton of balancing and polish," Thunder Lotus warned in the "Risks and Challenges" section of the Kickstarter page. "The amount of feedback we get from you guys can also impact our timeline, as we want to make sure that our backers are happy with the game before we ship it to the masses."

notes.title: Crafted with love: Jotun devs Sundered on Kickstarter

[h1] [i]Sundered[/i] Is On Kickstarter! [/h1]

Hey everyone! Huge news today, as we're revealing our [i]Sundered[/i] Kickstarter campaign!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thunderlotus/1569490481?token=26e71699] --> Preview the Sundered Kickstarter campaign (and share it too!) [/url]

We had a small, dedicated army of backers with us throughout the crucial testing phase of the [i]Jotun[/i] project, so we know firsthand how crucial the input of enthusiastic alpha and beta players is for making a good game [i]something special[/i]. To all the fans we've proudly recruited since day one, we want to be abundantly clear: we simply couldn't imagine completing [i]Sundered[/i] without repeating that great Kickstarter experience.

In short, the campaign’s goal is to get *you* involved in the process. It's about polish, feedback and making [i]Sundered[/i] the best it can be. We hope you'll check the campaign out, consider joining us for the alpha and/or beta, and share the campaign with any you believe might be interested.

[b]We'll be live on Kickstarter on January 16th[/b] - we hope to see you then! In the meantime, don't forget to click on "Notify me on launch" on our Kickstarter page so you don't miss out!

[h1] [i]Sundered[/i] Will Be Out This Summer! [/h1]

Cheers, 

#ResistOrEmbrace 

- Rodrigue and the Thunder Lotus Team

notes.title: Jotun studio Thunder Lotus announces Sundered, a Lovecraft-inspired "replayable Metroidvania"
notes.content:
Thunder Lotus Games, the maker of the Norse mythology action-exploration game Jotun, has announced a new project, based on a wholly different sort of pantheon, called Sundered. As creative director William Dub explained on the PlayStation Blog, it's a horrifying fight for survival and sanity in a ruined world filled with eldritch horrors.

Sundered is a game that builds on the strengths of Jotun: Hand-drawn art, epic boss battles, and great immersion, Dub said. However, we know Jotun was far from perfect. With Sundered, we ve added more complex mechanics, tons of replayability, and meaningful choices. We ve gone into a darker universe heavily inspired by Lovecraft s writings.

Dub described Sundered as mainly a replayable Metroidvania, close to Rogue Legacy and Super Metroid. The game world is procedurally generated, there will be multiple endings, and your abilities will be corruptible, which sounds interesting. Resist or embrace, as the tagline says. Harness the power of corrupted relics to defeat gigantic bosses, at the cost of your humanity.

There's not much to see yet at either Thunder Lotus' website or on Steam, but they're both live if you'd like to take a peek, and we've got a short trailer and some screens to look at too. Sundered is currently expected to be ready for launch sometime in 2017.

notes.title: Introducing Sundered, a Horrifying Fight for Survival and Sanity
notes.content:
Hello Steam!

We are super excited to bring you Thunder Lotus' sophomore game, Sundered!

Sundered is a horrifying fight for survival and sanity. You play Eshe, a wanderer trapped in ever-changing caverns teeming with eldritch horrors.

Building on ​Jotun’s success, we took what worked from the game (the art style, big boss fights and immersion) and fused it with infinite replayability and the non­linear action-­packed gameplay of the metroidvania genre.

We hope you'll enjoy the game and can't wait to tell you more!

As always, poke us in the comments or on Facebook/Twitter and we'll be happy to answer any of your questions!

Resists or Embrace.

- Will and the Thunder Lotus Team
